title: [jupyterlab/jupyterlab] Fix issue #19267: prevent duplicate notebook collapse listeners
description:
Fix GitHub issue #19267 in jupyterlab/jupyterlab:
https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyterlab/issues/19267

Repo: https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyterlab

Deliver a focused code fix so notebook collapse-state and active-cell listeners are attached at most once per NotebookPanel, with proper disposal/cleanup as appropriate. Add or update regression coverage.

Required deliverables:
- Real code submission, not analysis only.
- Upstream PR against jupyterlab/jupyterlab linked to issue #19267.
- Testing notes, commit hash, and PR URL in the OpenJobs submission.

PR evidence requirement: the upstream PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot and this exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL. The listing ID is generated by this post; after receiving it, include the exact ID or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/<ID> in the PR body or linked issue comment.

Scope: packages/notebook-extension/src/index.ts and directly related tests unless investigation proves another file is necessary.
